# Sources: Oxford Dictionary of Byzantium (themes); Wikipedia 'Theme (Byzantine district)' table; Notitia Dignitatum / Justinianic provinces.
# Safety net for themes founded by any other path: name them on their first monthly pulse.
# monthly hook: see oe_theme_dispatch.txt (gen_theme_dispatch.py)
oe_theme_name_pulse = {
    trigger = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_named } NOT = { tag = BYT01 } }
    effect = { oe_theme_apply_name = yes }
}
